notes.title: Patch December 3
notes.notes:
- (Fixed) Some rooms don't show on the map.
- Fixed a puzzle that didn't save the result correctly (in the Winter Lake area).
- Removed corridors where some players got stuck.
- Improved saving system for multiple puzzles to save the precise position of puzzle pieces.
- implemented auto-save after acquiring key items.
- (Fixed) Spikes projectiles are weaker than the regular attacks.
- (Fixed) Activated portals disappear after relaunching the game.
- Showing controls for the keyboard and gamepad at the starting area.

notes.title: Patch November 11
notes.notes:
- Updated the map to show open chests, flowers, and key doors.
- Added explicit descriptions to the items in the shop.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
• Small bug fixes
• Fixed issues with UI for Ultra-Wide screen resolution

notes.title: Limos' Lair is out!
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce, that after 2 years of development, my game, Limos' Lair, is finally out!

Thank you to everyone who supported the development, played the demos, and gave their feedback. 

I am grateful for your contribution to the project!

Enjoy the final game!
